US Bill Proposes 3-Year Pause on H-1B Visas, $100,000 Fee

A bill introduced in the US Senate proposes a three-year pause on new H-1B visas. The proposed legislation also seeks to codify a fee of $100,000 for certain H-1B visa holders. The bill was introduced by a US Senator, with specific details on the fee structure and its application to certain visa categories mentioned in the coverage.
